verdict.rationale: Graphite lets you choose which repositories Graphite Agent reviews automatically (docs-19), and comment exclusions can suppress comments in specified situations (docs-20). Graphite Chat lets you ask on demand for potential issues in a PR (docs-21). Otherwise the docs describe reviews running on every PR with no configuration (docs-4), so control is coarse. missing for 10: documented skipping of draft PRs, an explicit on-demand review trigger (e.g. a comment command), branch- or label-based filtering of when reviews run, details of what 'Automations' can do, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
